name: Have I Been Pwned
tagline: Industry-standard breach and paste search for compromised emails and passwords.
description: Have I Been Pwned provides APIs to check whether email addresses, domains, or passwords appear in known data breaches and paste dumps. Developers use the authenticated breach/paste endpoints and the k-anonymity Pwned Passwords range API for secure password checks without sending full passwords.

auth.details: hibp-api-key required for email/paste/protected-domain/stealer-log searches; breach catalogue and Pwned Passwords range endpoints unauthenticated.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Pwned Passwords range API free/unauthenticated; breach catalogue (/breaches, /breach/{name}) free; paid subscription required for email/paste/domain search. Limited free breach monitoring advertised separately.

rate_limits: Paid HIBP API keys rate-limited (~10 req/min standard); 429 with Retry-After. Pwned Passwords range has separate/high-volume guidance.
use_cases: check if an email appears in known data breaches
list all breaches for a domain
check if a password hash prefix appears in Pwned Passwords
get details for a named breach
monitor whether a user's email was in recent pastes
